title: dryopteris patens var. stipularis
intro: Dryopteris patens var. stipularis, commonly known as the golden-scaled buckler fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Dryopteris patens var. stipularis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
